question: For the telecommunications provider with ticker 'T', identify the key personnel affiliated with the organization and retrieve the headlines of recent media coverage referencing it.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Company {ticker: "T"})<-[:WORKS_FOR]-(p:Person)
WITH c, collect(p.name) AS key_personnel
MATCH (c)<-[:NEWS_ABOUT_COMPANY]-(n:News)
RETURN key_personnel, collect(n.headline) AS recent_headlines LIMIT 10
